name: -6AN to 7/8-20 Short Carburetor Inlet Fitting
title: -6AN to 7/8-20 Short Carburetor Inlet Fitting
description:
ColorFittings Short Carburetor Inlet Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN braided fuel lines directly to your carburetor's fuel bowl inlet, providing a secure, leak-free solution for carbureted fuel systems where space is limited in racing, street performance, and marine applications.

Each fitting is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. The short-style design is ideal for tight engine bays and low-clearance installations and is designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments.

Our Short Carburetor Inlet Fittings are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with our nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these fittings deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance carbureted fuel system.

For best installation results, we strongly recommend using our AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference our installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.

Looking to complete your system? Explore our full range of AN fittings, carburetor fittings, braided hose, and fitting assembly tools.
